context: The skill should keep boolean-only selector validation while removing value-read branches and avoiding fake collection/null workarounds.

checklist.name: Preserves mutual exclusion
checklist.description: Keeps the board/workflow mutual-exclusion check and preserves the exception message.

checklist.name: Classifies boolean-only validation
checklist.description: Recognizes that the conflict check may remain as isPresent() checks because no Optional value is read there.

checklist.name: Uses Optional selector boundaries
checklist.description: Replaces selector branches with board.map(...).orElseGet(...) and a nested workflow Optional boundary, or an equivalent direct Optional/value-binding shape.

checklist.name: No null workaround
checklist.description: Does not introduce orElse(null), value != null checks, or local null control flow.

checklist.name: No fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not convert either single Optional selector to stream().toList(), a list, or a loop.
